entities.name: Takenuma Swamp
entities.description: A fetid swamp on Kamigawa, major source of black mana, home to nezumi, humans, o-bakemono and oni.

entities.name: Kokusho
entities.description: The Evening Star, guardian spirit dragon of Takenuma.

entities.name: Junji
entities.description: Kokusho's reincarnation, who abandoned the swamp and presides over Towashi's Undercity.

entities.name: Kitanosu
entities.description: A nezumi village with a dilapidated temple.

entities.name: Miren
entities.description: A haunted well deep within the swamp.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: Group of buildings where humans live.

entities.name: Shizo
entities.description: An ancient battlefield with mummified corpses.

entities.name: Tomb of Urami
entities.description: A false monument that is an oni trap.

events.summary: Junji, Kokusho's reincarnation, abandons the swamp.
events.quote: Her reincarnation, Junji , abandoned the swamp

relations.quote: The guardian spirit dragon of Takenuma is Kokusho
